entities.summary: Anna Ottendorfer was a German-American journalist and philanthropist. She was associated with the development of the German-language New Yorker Staats-Zeitung into a major newspaper. Anna Ottendorfer was a performers & entertainers from Würzburg (1815-02-13, Würzburg–1884-04-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
